story: US-008 (external prerequisite ordering; affects US-009..US-019 start gating)
authorization_basis: Owner explicit AskUserQuestion decision 2026-08-26T14:40Z ('Start Rust now (Recommended)') after the benchmark-host feasibility investigation. The inherited external prerequisite independent-linux-benchmark-host-binding says the exact confirmation host must bind 'before US-008 passes or any sample, tuning, performance claim, or implementation story begins.'

amendment.from: No implementation story (US-009 onward) may begin before the independent Linux x86_64 confirmation host is bound.
amendment.to: Implementation stories (US-009 onward) MAY begin before the confirmation host binds. Everything measurement-related keeps its original gate unchanged: no benchmark sample may be collected, no tuning performed, no performance claim made, and US-008 cannot pass, until the exact confirmation host and every measurement/analyzer tool identity are preregistered and bound. Rust implementation work performed before binding must make no performance representations beyond compile/test correctness.
unchanged_invariants: No benchmark samples inside sbx (build/test preparation only)
Primary measurements run natively on the pinned macOS Apple M4 Pro environment
Confirmation requires a provenance-distinct dedicated/exclusively-reserved Linux x86_64 host (bare-metal preferred per the virtualization-overhead rationale)
Fixed sample counts, preregistered stats plan, no fabricated results

context: Confirmation-host plan per owner direction: a DIALED-derived, job-scoped PR pipeline in AWS (shape A: separate benchmark Terraform root, SSM-driven native run on a metal instance, same-job teardown, janitor sweep). Blocked on AWS account assignment, resolved by the owner's same-day decision to move this project into Enterprise Vibe Code.
